act_title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

quests.title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

dialogue.t: Is this how I'm supposed to spin? It hurts my toes. Is that normal?
Okay, so is being dizzy normal, too? I don't even get dizzy when I spin around in the water.
You're just a beginner, so yes.
Wait, how do you bear with the dizziness while you dance, then? You spin much harder than this.
What you need to do is pick a spot to focus on, then quickly whip your head around, like this. Now you try.
*sigh* You shore-folk live far more tiring lives than us water fae...
The solution is to keep practicing. On land, that is.
You'll have gotten used to it.
